entries.name: TCMSP (v2.3)
entries.license: Legacy home page: 'TCMSP is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0) ... individual contents under the Database Contents License (DbCL 1.0)' (https://old.tcmsp-e.com/tcmsp.php). ODbL permits redistribut…
entries.barriers: Legacy: none beyond per-page anti-scrape token embedded in home page. Next-gen platform (next.tcmsp-e.com): registration/login required for API; premium membership CNY 399/yr for tools (stated on tcmsp-e.com portal FAQ).
entries.assessment: Old site serves the data only inside HTML pages behind a per-page token; the new next.tcmsp-e.com API requires an account. Not scraped. Licence ODbL 1.0 / DbCL 1.0 permits reuse of data a person exports.

entries.name: TCM Database@Taiwan
entries.license: not stated (unreachable); paper describes it as non-commercial free database.
entries.assessment: Server times out (HTTP 503 from proxy); appears defunct; no mirrors found.

entries.name: TCMBank
entries.license: not stated; Help page: 'this query is used for academic purposes or drug delivery queries by TCM physicians'.
entries.barriers: None for download/API (login.js present for optional user features). HTTPS cert expired -> must use http:// or wait for renewal.
entries.assessment: Entity xlsx bulk files + undocumented but simple GET JSON API for relations; no auth.

entries.name: TCMSID
entries.license: not stated (unreachable)
entries.barriers: Database no longer hosted at its domain.
entries.assessment: Domain serves an unrelated third-party placeholder; dataset not obtainable online.

entries.name: NPASS 2.0
entries.license: Free for academic use
entries.assessment: Bulk files already acquired and parsed (sources.parsers.npass); used by the research loop.

entries.name: CMAUP 2.0
entries.license: Free for academic use
entries.assessment: Bulk files already acquired and parsed (sources.parsers.cmaup); used by the research loop.

entries.name: ccTCM
entries.license: not stated
entries.barriers: Backend on raw IP:3456 unreachable through this egress (timeout).
entries.assessment: Front-end loads but all data come from a raw-IP:3456 backend that times out from this environment.

entries.name: BATMAN-TCM 2.0
entries.license: Not stated on 2.0 pages; BATMAN-TCM 1.0 page: 'This web server is built and free for academics. For commercial use, please contact us!'
entries.assessment: Six complete TSV dumps (known and predicted ingredient-target pairs, herbs, formulas) are the dataset 'batman2'. The documented queryTarget/queryTcm API answered the survey, then returned 502 and timed out throughout verification; the connector is defined as pending (providers.public_apis_tcm.PENDING_TCM_SOURCES) and is registered once a verification run succeeds.

entries.name: HIT 2.0
entries.license: not stated (unreachable)
entries.barriers: Non-standard port 2345 times out from this environment (non-443 ports may not traverse proxy; also may be down).
entries.assessment: Real server on port 2345 times out; use HIT-derived data via BATMAN-TCM 2.0 / dbPTH.

entries.name: HIT 1.0
entries.license: not stated
entries.barriers: Page defaced/compromised; treat host as untrusted.
entries.assessment: Host defaced ('Hacked By ...'); treat as compromised and do not fetch from it.

entries.name: dbPTH 1.0
entries.license: Download page: 'All datasets and annotations are free for use.' Footer: 'Copyright 2023, Beijing University of Chinese Medicine and the CUCKOO Workgroup ... All Rights Reserved.' Redistribution terms not explicit.
entries.assessment: Large, free bulk text/SQL files; no API.

entries.name: PharmMapper
entries.license: 'PharmMapper Server is a freely accessed web-server' (home page); no data licence stated.
entries.barriers: Email-based job submission; runs take 1-2 h (old DB) to 20-24 h (ligandable DB); results kept >=45 days.
entries.assessment: Only an asynchronous email job service; no API or data dump - must be run manually per compound.

entries.name: HERB 2.0
entries.license: not stated on site/bundle
entries.barriers: none for download (UI toggles via download_switch.json); no login
entries.assessment: Nine V2 TSV entity tables are the dataset 'herb2'. Relations (a herb's ingredients and inferred targets/diseases, literature-graded targets, an ingredient's targets with their upstream source) come per entity from the JSON post HERB's own pages send (connector 'herb_api', dataset 'herb_api'), wrapped on the repository owner's decision of 2026-10-02 at 1 req/s, cached, no crawl.

entries.name: HERB 1.0
entries.license: not stated
entries.assessment: Use V1 TSVs from HERB 2.0 host; herb.ac.cn's own download endpoint is disabled.

entries.name: ETCM v2.0
entries.license: Terms & Conditions page in SPA (/Help/termsConditions) and registration links https://docs.cmnpd.org/terms-and-conditions; not fetched
entries.barriers: Registration/login exists (with terms checkbox -> https://docs.cmnpd.org/terms-and-conditions); backend on port 18124 unreachable from this environment
entries.assessment: Only static SPA shell reachable; all data come from :18124 which times out from this egress (would be web_export/undocumented API elsewhere).

entries.name: TCMID 2.0
entries.license: original: not determinable; Zenodo upload labelled CC-BY-4.0 (third-party)
entries.assessment: Origin times out; only a tiny unofficial herb table on Zenodo; TCMID ids survive as cross-refs in HERB 2.0/ITCM.

entries.name: TCMM
entries.license: Article is CC BY 4.0; data licence not stated
entries.barriers: expired TLS certificate (not bypassed); full data on request only
entries.assessment: Expired certificate blocks access; complete data only by contacting authors (restricted).

entries.name: TCM-Mesh
entries.license: not stated
entries.assessment: Hosting returns Cloudways domain-mapping error page; database offline.

entries.name: LTM-TCM
entries.license: not stated (bioinformaticshome lists 'Not licensed', free)
entries.assessment: Host NXDOMAIN.

entries.name: ITCM
entries.license: not stated
entries.assessment: Public TSV downloads incl. relation tables, plus GET JSON endpoints for live lookups (undocumented).

entries.name: TCM-ID
entries.license: not stated (about.html has no licence text)
entries.assessment: No bulk files or API; HTML detail pages only (per-record POST export).

entries.name: YaTCM
entries.license: not stated (paper: free web toolkit)
entries.assessment: Origin times out from this egress.

entries.name: CPMCP
entries.license: article CC BY-NC; data licence not stated
entries.assessment: Domain NXDOMAIN; partial coverage via HERB 2.0 formula table cross-refs.

entries.name: TCMKD
entries.license: not stated
entries.barriers: Origin 403 for this egress; via WebFetch the /TCMKD/help page shows a login wall with 'Register now' (/TCMKD/auth/register/)
entries.assessment: Login/registration required; origin blocks this egress.

entries.name: 古今医案云平台/方剂数据库
entries.license: '中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所版权所有'; no open licence
entries.barriers: Login (SMS mobile / institutional), Tencent CAPTCHA (TJCaptcha.js), trial limits
entries.assessment: Only aggregate stats public; case content requires login + CAPTCHA.

entries.name: 中国中医药数据库(CINTCM/CINTMED)
entries.license: 'Copyright 2017 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所 版权所有'; paid
entries.barriers: 登录 (login.html), 收费标准 page (paid/institutional subscription); described as closed ('封闭式') platform
entries.assessment: Login + fee schedule; no export/API.

entries.name: SymMap v2
entries.license: not stated; help page: files 'free to download'; 'Copyright © 2022, BUCM; ICT CAS; Beijing Jiaotong University'
entries.assessment: Entity xlsx files are the dataset 'symmap2'. The relations (a herb's ingredients, targets, symptoms, diseases, syndromes; an ingredient's targets) come per entity from the form post SymMap's own detail pages send (connector 'symmap', dataset 'symmap_api'), wrapped on the repository owner's decision of 2026-10-02 at 1 req/s, cached, no crawl.

entries.name: DCABM-TCM
entries.license: not stated on DCABM pages (sister BATMAN-TCM: free for academics, commercial use contact authors)
entries.assessment: Documented JSON query API for prescription/herb/ingredient blood exposure plus a structure file dump.

entries.name: MRTCM
entries.url: not found (no public URL located in paper abstract, reviews or web search)
entries.license: article CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (Crossref); data licence not stated
entries.barriers: unknown; described as a 'cloud-computing infrastructure' with no public endpoint cited
entries.assessment: No public site found; only the paper (and possibly its supplementary tables) is usable.

entries.name: HIM数据库
entries.license: paper: 'freely accessible to academic researchers'; data licence not stated
entries.assessment: Domain no longer resolves; only paper supplementary data could be used.

entries.name: TCMSTD（系统毒理学数据库）
entries.license: not stated
entries.barriers: login/register endpoints present (role unclear); backend down at test time
entries.assessment: Front end loads but its data API returned 503; recheck later; if it returns, it would be web_export via undocumented POST JSON.

entries.name: openFDA / FAERS
entries.license: CC0 1.0 / public domain (https://open.fda.gov/license/: 'public domain and made available with a Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal dedication')
entries.assessment: Documented, keyless JSON API with count aggregation, plus JSON bulk partitions.

entries.name: FDA FAERS季度原始文件
entries.license: US federal public domain (FDA data); no explicit licence on page
entries.assessment: Stable direct zip URLs per quarter; good for local snapshot and herbal-name mapping.

entries.name: TADRRS-HM（台湾）
entries.url: no public database site; national reporting portal https://adr.fda.gov.tw (TFDA)
entries.license: not stated
entries.barriers: reporting system behind login; case-level data not public
entries.assessment: Case data only via TFDA/NRICM; use paper supplementary aggregates.

entries.name: KAERS（韩国）
entries.url: https://open.drugsafe.or.kr (KIDS open data / KIDS-KAERS DB application)
entries.license: per KIDS data-use agreement; not public
entries.barriers: KIDS-KD raw data released on application and approval (study used 'Data No. 2205A0042')
entries.assessment: Application-only raw data; Korean hosts unreachable; figshare holds only summary tables.

entries.name: CADRMS/国家药品不良反应监测
entries.license: not stated (government site)
entries.barriers: case-level national ADR DB not public; reporting portal is login-based
entries.assessment: Only narrative/aggregate HTML annual reports (2009-2025); manual extraction of TCM figures.

entries.name: NCCIH HerbList
entries.license: US federal government content, generally public domain (credit NCCIH; some images excepted)
entries.assessment: Public-domain HTML pages, no data API; a person may save the pages they need.

entries.name: CancerHSP
entries.license: Not stated on CancerHSP page; parent TCMSP site states ODbL 1.0 / DbCL 1.0.
entries.assessment: Same page-token pattern as TCMSP; not scraped. A person may export tables and import them.

entries.name: DDID
entries.license: not stated (site only asks to cite)
entries.assessment: Direct CSV downloads cover all tables; host is flaky so snapshot once.

entries.name: PHYDGI
entries.url: no standalone public site; integrated in Synapse Medicine 'Synapse Prescribe' drug-interaction module (https://www.syna…
entries.license: proprietary
entries.assessment: Commercial, embedded in Synapse product; only the paper is public.

entries.name: TwoSIDES
entries.license: not stated on nsides.io or S3 README (GitHub API shows no licence on nsides-release/onsides)
entries.assessment: Static files on public S3 with bucket listing; ideal for snapshot.

entries.name: openFDA/FAERS（联用信号挖掘模式）
entries.license: CC0 1.0 / public domain (https://open.fda.gov/license/: 'public domain and made available with a Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal dedication')
entries.assessment: Documented, keyless JSON API with count aggregation, plus JSON bulk partitions.

entries.name: Natural Medicines（商业）
entries.license: proprietary, no redistribution
entries.assessment: Paywalled commercial reference; characterise only.

entries.name: Medscape Interaction Checker
entries.license: proprietary (WebMD/Medscape terms of use)
entries.barriers: free Medscape account encouraged; terms of use prohibit automated harvesting
entries.assessment: Undocumented internal API under restrictive commercial terms; characterise only.

entries.name: Stockley's Herbal Medicines Interactions
entries.license: proprietary (Royal Pharmaceutical Society)
entries.assessment: Subscription-only book/database; characterise only.

entries.name: DrugBank
entries.license: Full DB: CC BY-NC 4.0 (academic), commercial licence otherwise; Open Data vocabulary/structures: CC0
entries.barriers: account required for full DB; API paid; bot challenge blocks scripted download
entries.assessment: API and full database need an account or a paid key; the CC0 open vocabulary is behind a bot challenge here, so a person downloads it and it is imported as a local dataset.

entries.name: TCMIO
entries.license: not stated ('Copyright 2019 GDIM All rights reserved' footer)
entries.assessment: 9 direct XLSX/SDF downloads, frozen 2019 release.

entries.name: ImmPort
entries.license: ImmPort Data Use Agreement (https://docs.immport.org/home/agreement/): unrestricted right to use and distribute, redistribution on commensurate terms, cite data providers
entries.barriers: registration + data use agreement for study data downloads and token API; gene lists and study search open
entries.assessment: Open gene-list files and anonymous study search; study-level data needs a registered token.

entries.name: IEDB
entries.license: CC BY 4.0 (dc:terms license on iedb.org terms page)
entries.assessment: Documented keyless PostgREST API plus full zip exports.

entries.name: SuperTCM
entries.license: not stated
entries.barriers: host unreachable from this env (possibly decommissioned or blocked)
entries.assessment: DNS failure and proxy 502; cannot verify. Recheck from a non-proxied network.

entries.name: CINTCM
entries.license: 'Copyright 2017 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所 版权所有'; paid
entries.barriers: 登录 (login.html), 收费标准 page (paid/institutional subscription); described as closed ('封闭式') platform
entries.assessment: Login + fee schedule; no export/API.

entries.name: INPUT（网络药理平台）
entries.license: not stated ('Copyright @ ChenLab')
entries.barriers: none for browsing; analyses run via form submission
entries.assessment: Analysis platform with POST-only queries and no downloads; manual export only.

entries.name: TM-MC 2.0
entries.license: not stated on site
entries.assessment: Complete, documented xlsx dumps of all tables; no API.

entries.name: BATMAN-TCM 1.0
entries.license: 'This web server is built and free for academics. For commercial use, please contact us!' (1.0 home page)
entries.barriers: Job submission form for analysis (email optional); no login for download.
entries.assessment: Only the known-DTI flat file is retrievable programmatically; predictions require job submission - use 2.0 dumps instead.

entries.name: ShenNong-TCM-Dataset
entries.license: Apache-2.0 (HF card license: apache-2.0); README: '是完全开源的，可供社区成员们使用'. Content is ChatGPT-generated from a TCM KG; OpenAI ToS caveat for model training is not stated.
entries.assessment: Single 110 MB JSON on HF, ungated Apache-2.0; snapshot it (datasets-server API usable for previews only).

entries.name: TCM-NER
entries.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 per Tianchi dataset metadata (via web search; page is JS-rendered, not verified from HTML). Share-alike.
entries.barriers: Login (Alibaba Cloud/Tianchi account) required to download.
entries.assessment: Only obtainable after Tianchi login; a person must download once, then it can be stored as a local snapshot (CC BY-SA permits).

entries.name: TCM-Ladder
entries.license: CC-BY-4.0 (HF card)
entries.barriers: none on HF; tcmladder.com has /login,/register (not needed)
entries.assessment: Ungated CC-BY parquet files on HF; snapshot text parquets (~1.3 MB), visual/video optional.

entries.name: CMLM-ZhongJing数据
entries.license: Code: MIT (LICENSE). README badge 'Academic Use'; '仅供学术研究使用，未经允许不得商业使用' (models/outputs).
entries.barriers: Instruction data not public (proprietary); would require contacting authors.
entries.assessment: Dataset is described but not published; only model weights are public.

entries.name: herbnet（知识图谱）
entries.license: HerbNetSpace: no LICENSE file (not stated). HerbKG: LICENSE file present (Apache-2.0 from BioBERT code base, 12 KB).
entries.barriers: Data not released in repos (would need author contact).
entries.assessment: Name is ambiguous and none of the candidate repos publishes the KG itself; confirm the intended source with the requester.

entries.name: 中医医案知识图谱
entries.license: not stated (no LICENSE file)
entries.assessment: Repo publishes code + a 10-line sample; the full KG would need author contact (search found 26 'TCM-KG' repos, 114-star ywjawmw/TCM_KG is the main one).

entries.name: TCMP-300
entries.license: CC BY 4.0 (figshare metadata). Images collected via Bing search - underlying image copyright may vary.
entries.assessment: Figshare API gives stable metadata/file listing; species CSV (20 KB) is the useful table, image tarball only if vision work is needed.

entries.name: IGTCM
entries.license: not determined
entries.barriers: Host on port 96 unreachable from this environment (proxy limitation).
entries.assessment: Only served on a non-standard port that this egress cannot reach; re-test from an unrestricted network.

entries.name: TTD（Therapeutic Target Database）
entries.license: not stated on download page (citation requested; historically free for academic use)
entries.assessment: Plain static TSV/SDF files for a local snapshot; undocumented JSON API usable for per-ID lookups.

entries.name: MeSH
entries.license: NLM Terms and Conditions (https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/terms_and_conditions_mesh.html): 'NLM freely provides MeSH data', no fees; attribution / do-not-misrepresent conditions; MeSH translations (MTMS) not …
entries.assessment: Documented REST lookup + SPARQL already wrapped (id.nlm.nih.gov); annual XML for local snapshot.

entries.name: PreDC
entries.license: not stated
entries.barriers: Data pages redirect to a maintenance notice; download links disabled.
entries.assessment: Legacy site in 'maintenance' since migration of TCMSP; no download; only reachable via a redirect-leaked page body, which is not a sound access path.

entries.name: NPACT
entries.license: 'Copyright 2012. Subhash M. Agarwal. All Rights Reserved.' - no reuse licence stated.
entries.barriers: none for browsing; no bulk export.
entries.assessment: Only HTML pages, no download/API, all rights reserved and 20 s crawl delay; a person should export/request data, or rely on PubChem CIDs.
